title: civica Master Component Inventory
rules: This inventory is the sole source of truth for component parent pages. Change it only with the owner's approval, then update the pinned hash in scripts/check-components.mjs.
Each parent has exactly one page at its route. Each child and grandchild is a section with the given anchor on that page.
An entry with cross_reference is documented on its owner page; the secondary page links to it.
Every ha- and hui- element is verified against the pinned Home Assistant frontend source before it is documented; unverified names are reported, never invented or dropped.
Where Home Assistant registers an element by YAML type (card features, selectors, rows), the page documents both the YAML type key and the element name.
